title: Kicked Crispy Turkish Peach Kebabs
description: A spicy and crispy Turkish dish featuring caramelized peaches, perfect for a lazy Sunday, and is flexitarian-friendly. This recipe is cooked on a salt block for added flavor.
instructions: Preheat the salt block in the oven at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 30 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, red pepper flakes, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced red onion, bell peppers, and zucchini to the bowl and toss to coat with the oil mixture.
Thread the marinated vegetables and peaches onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Place the skewers on the preheated salt block and cook for 20 minutes, turning occasionally.
After 20 minutes, increase the oven temperature to broil and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the peaches are caramelized.
Remove the skewers from the oven and sprinkle with crumbled feta cheese and chopped parsley, if using.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
